answer: Resist sybils by tying reputation to a verifiable vine of completed work: each agent's past jobs, attestations, and slashed bonds form one unbroken chain that cannot be cloned cheaply. A fresh identity starts at an oasis of zero trust and must earn its way up through small, audited tasks before touching real value, so one operator spinning up thousands of shells gains no pearl of privilege without paying the full cost in time, stake, and proven history for every single copy.
